title: Collect accepts and select the acceptor
spec: Add src/payer/select.ts: collectAccepts({ offerId, feeder, untilMs, avoid, isFleet, graceMs }) gathers verified accept frames with ref === offerId until expiry. Selection rule: skip DIDs in avoid; after the first accept from a fleet DID keep collecting for graceMs and prefer a non-fleet acceptor if one shows up; otherwise the first eligible. Return { status: "expired" } with no accepts, { status: "declined", acceptors } when only avoided DIDs accepted, or { status: "selected", accept, others }.
done: The three recorded accept sequences resolve to selected/declined/expired with the expected acceptor.
